reachable: Yes, at the scored position specifically, and the mechanism gets gradient in training. (1) The read command token carries the 48-sparse identity atom of the path being read, and every cups_test read in the sample has its path appearing VERBATIM as an earlier mv destination (24/24), so an attention head at the scored position has an exact-string match target one hop away: <code(cat Q), code(mv P Q)> = 947.75 against ~4 for unrelated commands. (2) The role sign makes 'moved INTO my path' separable from 'moved OUT of my path' (1087.25 vs 947.75) with one linear functional, exactly as claimed — though the directional contrast is 144 out of ~1050 because the id block, which carries 92% of the match energy, is deliberately role-blind. (3) Training: the code is applied inside collate for every batch, so the coded tokens are what the net is trained on; scoring reproduces it through code_cmds, which the harness gate checks against the real collate. Prefix-causality verified at every cut of a real 31-step sequence. (4) The r3 head's bridge mining reads tok[:,0::2], i.e. the CODED command tokens (evolve/chunks/head/r3_rename_registry_occupancy_routing.py:317, _mine_bridges), so the claimed interaction with the head is structurally real. (5) 4 transformer layers (r18 default) for the depth-3/4 eligible slice, matching the hypothesis's own framing of the hop budget.
solves_outside_model: CLEAN — nothing is resolved outside the model. _cmd_code(cmd) is a pure function of one command string: it hashes the command's own source path, its own destination/redirect target, its own verb, and eleven live syntax flags. There is no cross-command state, no file->location dictionary, no board simulation, no use of step metadata (the deltas in meta['delta_text'] that would give the answer away are never touched). code_cmds maps position i from cmds[i] alone. Verified by execution, not just by reading: coding a real 31-step sequence and coding every one of its 31 prefixes agree on every shared position; and swapping two move commands (a stronger perturbation than the probe's role swap, which keeps destinations and exchanges sources) leaves every read token bit-identical (max |native - swapped| = 0.0) while changing the swapped move tokens by 12.57. This is not the shape of the retracted +0.9026 stream. Parsing commands to write a per-command symbol code is exactly the legal case the brief describes ('Coding the move commands themselves is fine — the model still has to integrate them').
summary:
The stream code — the artifact this slot actually contributes — matches its specification with unusual precision, and the author's out-of-jail arithmetic is faithful. All five inner products the hypothesis reports as measured reproduce to rounding: claimed 1087/948/4/40/1064, actual 1087.25/947.75/4.25/40.25/1064.00. The role block's additive self-inversion is exact (residual 0.0). Atoms are exactly k-sparse, balanced and distinct for all 293 real paths; suffix variants stay near-orthogonal (magic.txt vs magic.txt.1 id-inner 20.25 against 972 self). Parsing handles all 400 unique real commands with zero failures, including the cvar arm's `cat A > B` / `>>` redirect forms, and every path a command mentions is coded. Observation tokens, targets, layout and candidate bank are untouched, and collate is bit-identical to the baseline when no cmds are supplied. Prefix-causal and read-token-invariant under swap, verified by execution.

The divergences are all in the crossover RATIONALE, not the mechanism, and two of them are flatly false. The hypothesis says the r18 optim's addressing branch is inert on the parent because the parent's arch lacks (key_d x d) addressing projections and a (D,D) readout. It does not lack them: r22 subclasses R18PathStateLatentTransition, and running the optim's own make() on both nets yields the identical 8 Muon params and 1 capped param. Relatedly, the r19 arch it swaps in is bit-identical to the parent's forward (max diff 0.0) whenever no type-2 tokens exist — and this stream never emits type 2, so r19's headline imagination path never fires. The live content of the arch swap is therefore: delete the parent's training-time observation-occlusion augmentation. Anyone reading the archive entry would take away a causal story about un-inerting an optimizer branch that is simply not true.

What I could not check: the premise the whole design rests on — that the frozen pooled embeddings make path identity not linearly available — is unmeasurable in this checkout (no encoder, no embedding cache; the author also flags it as unmeasured). The bridge-mining cosines (0.67/0.61/0.34/0.36) are a simulation with assumed base cosines; I reproduced them from the real code vectors under those same assumptions (0.666/0.606/0.338), so the arithmetic is internally faithful, but whether the r3 head's j_star at an interior chain link lands on the read or on the next move (whose target is the constant mv observation) is not determined by the code alone. And nothing was trained: whether a code carrying 58-75% of each command token's energy costs more in general next-obs prediction than it buys in binding is exactly the risk the author names and it remains open. Given the measured 0.0227 noise floor, a single three-seed draw will not settle it.
